```{r}
source("funcs.R")

set.seed(00333466 + 00329922)

simulate_linear_data = function(N, lambda, mu){

  dados = data.frame(
    a = integer(N),
    b = integer(N),
    t = numeric(N)
  )

  for(i in 1:N){

    a = sample(0:20, 1)
    t = runif(1, 0.1, 3)

    process = BDP(
      a = a,
      t_max = t,
      method = "linear",
      theta = c(lambda, mu)
    )

    b = tail(process$state, 1)

    dados[i, ] = c(a, b, t)
  }

  return(dados)

}

dados = simulate_linear_data(
  N = 75,
  lambda = 0.5,
  mu = 0.2
)

tempo = Sys.time()
trajetoria = EM_linear(dados$a, dados$b, dados$t, c(0.5, 0.5), K = 35, M0 = 15, Mj = 15, J = 60, max_iter = 5)
tempo_final = Sys.time() - tempo
tempo_final
```
